supplements.title: Interactions between nutrition and the epigenome: how can it be harnessed for public health?
supplements.summary: Diet influences how genes are expressed through epigenetic changes, offering potential for public health strategies to prevent disease and aging.

supplements.title: Higher serum zinc micronutrient levels are associated with reduced susceptibility to Group B Streptococcus rectovaginal colonisation in pregnant women.
supplements.summary: Higher zinc levels in pregnant women reduce Group B Streptococcus colonization, potentially lowering newborn infection risk.

supplements.title: Multi-omics and network pharmacology identify IGFBP1 as an m6A-Epigenetic target of pueraria in NSCLC therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified IGFBP1 as a therapeutic target in lung cancer, finding that Pueraria compounds can bind to it and potentially block cancer progression.

supplements.title: Molecular mechanism of anticancer activity of selected coastal marsh plants from Saudi Arabia.
supplements.summary: Coastal marsh plant extracts, especially A. marina, kill multiple cancer cell types by triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis through specific gene pathway changes.

supplements.title: Oral ginger-derived extracellular vesicles ameliorate arthritis via anti-inflammatory actions of microRNA-149 and 6-gingerol.
supplements.summary: Oral ginger-derived vesicles reduce inflammation and joint damage in rheumatoid arthritis through anti-inflammatory molecules.

supplements.title: Amino acid supplementation enhances in vivo efficacy of lipid nanoparticle-mediated mRNA delivery in preclinical models.
supplements.summary: Adding specific amino acids alongside lipid nanoparticles significantly boosts mRNA delivery and expression in cells and tissues.

supplements.title: Analysis and prediction of the burden of lung cancer attributable to diet low in fruits in China and the global from 1990 to 2021.
supplements.summary: Low fruit intake significantly contributes to lung cancer burden in China and globally, with projections showing continued growth through 2046.

supplements.title: Protective Effects of Opuntiol on Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Acute Kidney Injury in Mice.
supplements.summary: Opuntiol, a natural flavonoid, protects mouse kidneys from injury by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death.

supplements.title: CC8, a heterodimeric disintegrin from Cerastes cerastes snake venom, triggers apoptosis and restrains the dissemination of human glioblastoma cells.
supplements.summary: Snake venom protein CC8 kills glioblastoma cells and stops them from spreading, offering a potential new brain cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Interplay between colorectal cancer-related lifestyles and the gut microbiome: an exploratory analysis of metagenomic data.
supplements.summary: Researchers found that gut bacteria may influence how lifestyle factors affect colorectal cancer risk in adults.

supplements.title: Nodakenin attenuates cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury by modulating the PI3K/AKT/NF-κB signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Nodakenin protects the brain from ischemia-reperfusion injury by blocking inflammation and oxidative stress pathways.

supplements.title: Cardioprotective effect of spirulina on cafeteria diet-induced cardiac injury in silico and in vivo study.
supplements.summary: Spirulina protects heart tissue from damage caused by unhealthy diet through antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects in rats.

supplements.title: Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity: Comprehensive Pathway Insights and Advanced Preclinical Therapeutics.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified multiple mechanisms causing heart damage from doxorubicin cancer drug and found that probiotics and natural compounds may help prevent it.

supplements.title: Tetrahydropalmatine alleviates cancer induced bone pain by inhibiting TRPV1-SP-mediated macrophage recruitment and promoting M2 polarization.
supplements.summary: Tetrahydropalmatine reduces cancer-induced bone pain by blocking immune cell recruitment and switching immune cells to protective types.

supplements.title: Natural triterpenoid Ardisiacrispin B attenuates colitis-associated cancer via JAK2/STAT3 pathway and gut microbiota modulation.
supplements.summary: Ardisiacrispin B, a natural compound, reduces colitis-associated colorectal cancer in mice by suppressing inflammation and promoting tumor cell death.

off_label.title: Combining lenalidomide with IL-2 family of cytokines enhances activating receptor and perforin/granzyme expression in NK cells.
off_label.summary: Combining lenalidomide with IL-2 cytokines boosts natural killer cell activity, potentially improving cancer treatment while reducing side effects.

off_label.title: Low-dose nivolumab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy in borderline resectable oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma: a phase II trial.
off_label.summary: Low-dose immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy improved surgical conversion rates in borderline resectable oral cancer.

off_label.title: Conserved use of tetraspanin CD9 as an entry receptor by rhabdoviruses spanning multiple genera.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified CD9 protein as a shared entry receptor for multiple rhabdoviruses across species and found nitazoxanide as a potential broad-spectrum antiviral treatment.

off_label.title: Accelerated discovery of cell migration regulators using label-free deep learning-based automated tracking.
off_label.summary: DeepBIT, a label-free AI tracking system, rapidly identified breast cancer cell migration regulators among FDA-approved drugs and genetic perturbations.

off_label.title: Safety and Efficacy of Esomeprazole-Containing Regimens for Helicobacter pylori Eradication: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.
off_label.summary: Esomeprazole-based treatments effectively and safely eliminate H. pylori bacteria, reducing gastric cancer risk in both new and previously treated patients.

off_label.title: Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity: Comprehensive Pathway Insights and Advanced Preclinical Therapeutics.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified multiple mechanisms causing heart damage from doxorubicin cancer drug and found that probiotics and natural compounds may help prevent it.

off_label.title: A hierarchical theranostic nanoagent for multimodal imaging and targeted foam cell intervention in atherosclerosis.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle that images atherosclerotic plaques and delivers cholesterol-lowering drugs directly to foam cells, stabilizing dangerous arterial plaques.

off_label.title: Single-cell RNA Sequencing Discovered Subtypes Associated with Angiogenesis and Propranolol Treatment in Infantile Hemangioma.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified two infantile hemangioma cell types targeted by propranolol, revealing how the drug suppresses blood vessel growth.

off_label.title: DGAT1 Inhibition Induces Ferroptosis and Enhances Cancer Immunotherapy Efficacy.
off_label.summary: Blocking DGAT1 protein triggers cancer cell death and boosts immune checkpoint therapy effectiveness by increasing immune cell infiltration.

off_label.title: Longitudinal clinical and preclinical studies identify hetrombopag as a potent chelator for systemic iron overload.
off_label.summary: Hetrombopag, an existing aplastic anemia drug, effectively removes excess iron from the blood and prevents iron-related organ damage.

off_label.title: Bleeding Risk with Apixaban vs. Rivaroxaban in Acute Venous Thromboembolism.
off_label.summary: Apixaban and rivaroxaban treat blood clots similarly, but researchers are still determining which causes fewer bleeding complications.

off_label.title: Semaglutide alleviates ovarian ferroptosis in polycystic ovary syndrome and is associated with reduced GPX4 promoter hypermethylation.
off_label.summary: Semaglutide improves polycystic ovary syndrome by reversing ovarian cell damage through reducing harmful DNA methylation patterns.

off_label.title: Inhibition of NAMPT targets DNA damage response to sensitize alkylating chemotherapy in TP53 mutant mantle cell lymphoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking NAMPT in TP53-mutant mantle cell lymphoma makes cancer cells vulnerable to chemotherapy by disrupting DNA damage response.

off_label.title: Management of Treatment Resistant EGFR Inhibitor-Induced Papulopustular Exanthema With Isotretinoin and Dapsone.
off_label.summary: Isotretinoin and dapsone effectively treat severe skin rashes caused by cancer drugs when standard antibiotics fail.

off_label.title: MCT1 inhibition reprograms Treg metabolism via ABC transporters: implications for tumor immunity and the prognosis of acute myeloid leukemia patients.
off_label.summary: Blocking MCT1 in immune cells disrupts their metabolism and activates a pathway linked to better survival in acute myeloid leukemia patients.

biomarkers.title: Polarization of tumor-infiltrating macrophages predicts complete response to neoadjuvant treatment in patients with rectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Rectal cancer patients with more inflammatory and fewer anti-inflammatory tumor macrophages before treatment show complete response to neoadjuvant therapy.

biomarkers.title: Interactions between nutrition and the epigenome: how can it be harnessed for public health?
biomarkers.summary: Diet influences how genes are expressed through epigenetic changes, offering potential for public health strategies to prevent disease and aging.

biomarkers.title: Evaluating the Feasibility of Breast-Conserving Surgery in Breast Cancer Patients with Suspicious Calcifications After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
biomarkers.summary: Breast cancer patients with suspicious calcifications may still be eligible for breast-conserving surgery after chemotherapy, depending on imaging changes.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the mechanism of polymorphonuclear neutrophils against sepsis based on immune model.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers studied how immune cells called neutrophils contribute to sepsis damage, aiming to improve understanding of this life-threatening infection response.

biomarkers.title: PPRC1 is a prognostic biomarker and key regulator of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation in multiple myeloma.
biomarkers.summary: PPRC1 protein predicts outcomes and controls energy production in multiple myeloma, offering potential new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Multimodal MRI radiomics for predicting HIFU ablation efficacy in uterine fibroids: a machine learning study.
biomarkers.summary: Machine learning analysis of MRI scans predicts which uterine fibroids will respond well to ultrasound ablation treatment.

biomarkers.title: Incomplete thermal ablation accelerates local and systemic tumor progression in an immunocompetent prostate cancer model.
biomarkers.summary: Incomplete heat treatment of prostate cancer paradoxically speeds up tumor growth in mice with functioning immune systems.

biomarkers.title: Tetraspanin CD82 shapes EGFR signaling outcomes through nanoscale receptor organization.
biomarkers.summary: CD82 protein reorganizes EGFR on cell surfaces, altering how it signals and potentially offering new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Isolated dysphagia masking myasthenia gravis diagnosis.
biomarkers.summary: Difficulty swallowing alone delayed myasthenia gravis diagnosis for 15 months until a chest scan revealed an underlying thymoma tumor.

biomarkers.title: Switching of the c-Myc protein degradation pathway depending on the PP2A-B55α complex levels.
biomarkers.summary: PP2A-B55α acts as a molecular switch controlling two different pathways that break down the cancer-promoting c-Myc protein.

biomarkers.title: Responsive Nanomolecular Probes for Evolving Liver Diseases: Technological Revolutions and Challenges.
biomarkers.summary: Responsive nanoprobes enable earlier, more precise liver disease detection by visualizing molecular changes rather than traditional imaging methods.

biomarkers.title: Research Advances in the Application of Aptamers for Hematologic Malignancies.
biomarkers.summary: Aptamers show promise for diagnosing and treating blood cancers like leukemia and lymphoma better than conventional antibodies.

biomarkers.title: CT Radiomics-Based Machine Learning Model for Predicting Capsular and Neural Invasion in Thyroid Carcinoma: Diagnostic Accuracy Study.
biomarkers.summary: Machine learning analyzed CT scans to predict aggressive thyroid cancer features, improving preoperative diagnosis without invasive testing.

biomarkers.title: EXAGO: An Argonaute-Based Primer-Free Exponential Amplification Strategy for Ultrasensitive Zero-Background Detection of Point Mutation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed EXAGO, a new detection method using Argonaute protein to identify a lung cancer mutation with ultrasensitive accuracy in blood samples.

biomarkers.title: Predominant Merkel Cell Polyomavirus DNA Detection in Essential Thrombocythemia within Myeloproliferative Neoplasms.
biomarkers.summary: Merkel cell polyomavirus DNA is significantly more prevalent in essential thrombocythemia patients than healthy controls, suggesting a potential viral link to this blood cancer.

trials.title: Polarization of tumor-infiltrating macrophages predicts complete response to neoadjuvant treatment in patients with rectal cancer.
trials.summary: Rectal cancer patients with more inflammatory and fewer anti-inflammatory tumor macrophages before treatment show complete response to neoadjuvant therapy.

trials.title: Evaluating the Feasibility of Breast-Conserving Surgery in Breast Cancer Patients with Suspicious Calcifications After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
trials.summary: Breast cancer patients with suspicious calcifications may still be eligible for breast-conserving surgery after chemotherapy, depending on imaging changes.

trials.title: Prevalence and Relative Proportions of Multiple Sclerosis, Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder, and Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein Antibody-Associated Disease in the Republic of Korea.
trials.summary: This study isn't about cancer—it examines the prevalence of three neurological diseases (MS, NMOSD, and MOGAD) in Korea.

trials.title: International Consensus on the Evaluation and Management of Hypothalamic Hamartomas: Results From a Modified Delphi Survey.
trials.summary: Experts worldwide reached consensus on how to best evaluate and treat rare brain lesions called hypothalamic hamartomas that cause epilepsy.

trials.title: Real-world comparison of enzalutamide and apalutamide in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer: a multi-institutional propensity score-matched analysis.
trials.summary: Two prostate cancer drugs, enzalutamide and apalutamide, showed similar effectiveness when combined with standard treatment for advanced prostate cancer.

trials.title: PD-1 inhibitor treatment outcomes for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma in patients over 85: a comparative analysis.
trials.summary: PD-1 inhibitor drugs show promise for treating advanced skin cancer in patients over 85, though safety data remains limited.

trials.title: Pembrolizumab With or Without Lenvatinib as First-Line Therapy for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Phase III LEAP-010 Study.
trials.summary: Adding lenvatinib to pembrolizumab improved first-line treatment outcomes for advanced head and neck cancer.

trials.title: Cryoablation Activates the cGAS-STING-CXCL10 Axis in Macrophages to Enhance Anti-Tumor Immunity in NSCLC.
trials.summary: Freezing lung tumors activates immune cells to release a protein that recruits cancer-fighting T cells, improving treatment outcomes.

trials.title: Cancer interception with KRAS inhibitors in preclinical models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: KRAS inhibitors shrink precancerous pancreatic lesions and significantly extend survival in pancreatic cancer mouse models.

trials.title: A CD138+ tumor-associated macrophage-Siglec-F+ neutrophil feedforward loop promotes immune evasion in pancreatic cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified immune cells in pancreatic cancer that help tumors escape immune attack, and blocking them with antibodies improved treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Prednisolone modulates CD8⁺ and regulatory T-cell activity to dampen response to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in melanoma.
trials.summary: Prednisolone steroid treatment dampens melanoma patients' immune response to checkpoint inhibitor therapy by suppressing cancer-fighting T-cells.

trials.title: Low-dose nivolumab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy in borderline resectable oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma: a phase II trial.
trials.summary: Low-dose immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy improved surgical conversion rates in borderline resectable oral cancer.

trials.title: Viral mimicry may help explain immunogenic cell death.
trials.summary: A gold compound kills colorectal cancer cells by mimicking viral infection, triggering strong immune responses against tumors.

trials.title: Biodegradable targeted polymeric mRNA nanoparticles enable in vivo CD19 CAR T cell generation and lead to B cell depletion.
trials.summary: Researchers delivered CAR-T cell instructions directly into the body using targeted nanoparticles, successfully generating therapeutic cells without ex vivo manufacturing for B cell cancers.

trials.title: Insights into inherited genetic variations and genetic ancestry of patients with high-risk melanoma.
trials.summary: Most melanoma patients in this study had European ancestry, highlighting the need for more diverse genetic research to improve treatment predictions.
